description: One-cell foliage with independently colored constant-size leaf sprites, native preview rotation and persistent surface attachment twist. Hytale 0.7.2.
changes: Separate visible bounds from one-voxel block hitboxes
Increase leaf count rather than per-leaf scale; repeat a 2 brown : 2 orange : 1 gold group
Expose native PlaceBlock packet and client-selected rotation through the custom server interaction; delegate floor placement to native code
Remove obsolete filler voxels only for these leaf IDs when sections load; preserve root cells and unrelated blocks
advantages: Preserves old item IDs and approved tree assets
disadvantages: Client appearance and interactive rotation preview still await user acceptance
Generated silhouettes are not pixel-identical to native source
test_results: 168 native create assertions and 24 restart assertions passed; actual client-sync interaction data, three sizes and four yaw rotations
Three editor models valid; same individual physical dimensions, exact 2:2:1 counts and native icons
Saved legacy filler removed on reload; root and unrelated filler preserved
